player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee ciyaarta SimpleTak. On board, dhagaxyada aad u muuqataa sida '{player_stone}' iyo dhagaxyada aad ka soo horjeeda muuqan sida '{opponent_stone}'. On aad u jeedo, dooro hal cell madhan (by ay index tiriyey) iyo meel dhagax aad halkaas. Tusaale ahaan, '[12]' dhigeysa dhagax aad ee cell 12.

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Qaabka guuritaanka oo aan sax ahayn
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Lambarka unugyada aan sax ahayn {cell_num}. Waa inuu u dhexeeyaa 0 ilaa {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Fasalka {cell_num} waa mid horey loo qabsaday. Dooro qol madhan.

board.current_state: Guddiga hadda jira: {rendered_board} Dhaqdhaqaaqyada la heli karo: {available_moves}

action.placement: Ciyaaryahanka {current_player_id} wuxuu calaamadiisa ({symbol}) ku dhigay unugga {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Ciyaaryahanka {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') wuxuu isku xiray laba gees oo ka soo horjeeda!
